timings: 08:30 PM for Boys Hostel, 07:00 PM for Girls Hostel
mess_schedule: Breakfast: 7:30-9:00 AM, Lunch: 12:30-2:00 PM, Dinner: 7:30-9:00 PM
discipline: Biometric entry strictly monitored. Late entry after curfew without prior warden permission incurs a fine of Rs. 500.

rule: Hostel Room Allocation and Furniture Maintenance
timings: Annual allocation during July semester registration
discipline: Students are responsible for furniture, fan, tube light, and cupboard allocated to them. Willful damage leads to recovery costs plus penalty.

timings: 7 Days a week with rotating multi-cuisine menu
mess_schedule: 4 meals per day including evening tea and snacks at 05:00 PM
discipline: Food wastage is strictly discouraged. Taking mess utensils or food plates to hostel rooms is strictly prohibited.

rule: Hostel Out-Pass and Leave Application Procedure
timings: Out-pass requests must be applied 24 hours in advance via CampusIQ
discipline: Weekend home passes require SMS/telephonic confirmation from registered parent mobile number before gate clearance is issued.

rule: Zero Tolerance Against Ragging in Hostels
discipline: Any form of ragging, harassment, or intimidation results in immediate expulsion from college and police FIR under Telangana Prohibition of Ragging Act.
Use of high-power immersion heaters, electric stoves, induction cookers, and irons in rooms is banned due to fire safety hazards.

rule: Visitor and Day-Scholar Policy in Hostels
timings: Visitor hours: 04:30 PM - 06:30 PM on Sundays only
mess_schedule: Guest coupons available at mess counter
discipline: Day-scholar students and unauthorized external guests are strictly forbidden from entering hostel rooms. Violation results in disciplinary action.

rule: Hostel Wi-Fi and Silent Study Hours
discipline: Playing loud music, shouting, or creating disturbances during designated silent study hours is penalized.

mess_schedule: Dietary sick meals provided upon request
discipline: Any medical illness or sudden fever must be reported to floor supervisor immediately for prompt medical attention.

timings: Annual fee payment in single or two installments
mess_schedule: Mess fee calculated on dividing system
discipline: Hostel admission is valid for one academic year. Mid-year vacating does not entitle refund of room rent except caution deposit.

rule: Drinking, Smoking and Substance Abuse Prohibition
discipline: Possession or consumption of alcohol, tobacco, e-cigarettes, or contraband substances leads to instant expulsion from hostel and academic suspension.
Commercial coin/token operated washing machines available on each floor. Professional laundry pickup twice a week.

rule: Hostel Gym and Recreation Common Rooms
discipline: Recreation hall equipped with LED TV, satellite channels, carrom, table tennis, and daily newspapers in English and Telugu.

timings: Daily floor sweeping, weekly deep cleaning
discipline: Students must keep their rooms tidy and allow housekeeping staff to perform routine cleaning during morning hours.

timings: Open until 02:00 AM during examination weeks
discipline: Air-conditioned common study halls available on 1st and 3rd floors for late-night exam revisions in silence.
Corridors, entry gates, and common areas are monitored by CCTV for student safety. Tampering with cameras is a severe offense.
Students are strongly advised not to keep large amounts of cash or expensive gold jewelry in rooms. College is not liable for personal theft.
Grievances regarding mess quality, plumbing, or electrical issues can be submitted directly via CampusIQ Grievance portal.
Students going home for summer/winter breaks can store labeled trunks in the central luggage cloak room under lock and key.

timings: Day and night parking in designated bays
discipline: Two-wheelers must have college security sticker pass and helmet is mandatory for entry. Rash driving inside campus is banned.
